headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Leverage public trend signals to improve ClearInstall's real-time dependency analysis, ensuring users are aware of potential risks before installation. Integrate machine learning for predictive insights and enhance the user interface for better accessibility.
actions: Integrate deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype to dynamically analyze dependencies in real-time, providing instant risk assessments.
Utilize storytold/craft-anything to create a more intuitive and accessible user interface that highlights potential risks and provides clear explanations.
